emptyText: If a stage is disputed, it will appear here — with status, deadline and outcome.
fixRoundsExhaustedText: Both rounds are used up. What remains: a discount by amendment, closing by mutual consent, or court.
evidencePreviewUnavailable: No preview available — download the original.
resubmitNote: Once the fix is delivered, the stage goes back to acceptance and the acceptance window starts over.
discountAmountHint: A discount lowers the stage amount; the currency must match the stage.
antiWaiverDefault: The discount covers only the stated defect and waives no other claims.
antiWaiverHint: Recommended wording. You can edit it, but the field is required.
discountCreatedText: The discount is drawn up as an amendment: it takes effect once both parties sign it. There is no separate «accept» button — accepting is signing.
resolveAcceptedConfirm: Close the dispute by mutual consent? This cannot be undone.
resolveCourtConfirm: Escalate the dispute to court? Inside the platform this is the final outcome.
closedText: No actions remain: the outcome is recorded and has reached both parties' reputation cards.
evidenceCameraStub: Camera capture is coming to the app — for now upload a ready file.
windowNotAnchored: The clock starts once the notice appears in the personal area
contestNote: An objection triggers no automatic consequences — it records your position and moves the matter into dialogue.
warrantyDescriptionHint: Describe the defect: what exactly appeared and where.
warrantyEvidenceRequired: At least one piece of evidence is required — a claim cannot be reviewed on words alone.
warrantyNoAnchor: The contract has no stages — there is nothing to attach the evidence to.
warrantyEmptyText: You can submit a claim from the contract card while the warranty period lasts.
errorUnknown: That did not work. Please try again.
errorFixRoundsExhausted: Fix rounds are exhausted: there are only two. What remains: a discount by amendment, closing by consent, or court.
errorFixAlreadyResubmitted: The fix for this round has already been delivered.
errorAlreadyResolved: The dispute is already closed — no actions remain.
errorInvalidTransition: This action is not available in the current state of the dispute.
errorDiscountAlreadyDecided: This discount proposal has already been decided.
errorWindowClosed: The objection window is already closed.
errorDiscountNotApplicable: A discount cannot be drawn up here: the amount must be lower than the stage amount and in the same currency, and a warranty dispute has no stage at all.
errorChecklistItemRequired: The checklist item does not belong to this stage.
errorWarrantyPeriodNotActive: The warranty period is not running: claims are accepted only while it lasts.
errorWrongSide: This action is available to the other side.
errorNotCounterparty: This action is available to the other party.
errorPermissionDenied: You are not a party to this contract.
discountPendingText: The discount is set out in an amendment — it takes effect once both parties sign.
warrantyRoundsExhaustedText: Both “not fixed” objections have been used. What remains: confirm the fix, the contractor declines, or court.
warrantyFixNote: The customer then gets a confirmation window — the same length as the milestone acceptance period. If the customer does not respond, the claim closes automatically.
warrantyDeclineNote: Declining closes the claim and the dispute with the outcome “claim declined”. The customer will receive your comment.
warrantySatisfyConfirm: Confirm that the defect has been fixed? The claim and the dispute will close with the outcome “claim satisfied”.
warrantyContestNote: Describe what exactly is still not fixed. The claim goes back to the contractor; at most two objections are allowed.
warrantyConfirmAutoNote: If you do not respond, the claim closes automatically.
warrantyWaitingText: The customer will confirm the fix or object — {{left}} left · until {{date}}
feedWarrantyAutoSatisfied: Confirmation period expired — claim closed automatically
errorWarrantyAlreadyResolved: The warranty claim is already closed.
errorWarrantyDisputeMissing: The claim has no dialogue — contact support.
errorWarrantyFixRoundsExhausted: “Not fixed” objections exhausted: there are only two. What remains: confirm the fix, the contractor declines, or court.
errorWarrantyNotAwaiting: Nothing to object to: the contractor has not reported a fix yet.
errorWarrantyAlreadyAwaiting: The claim is already awaiting customer confirmation.

howItems.title: The platform does not decide who is right
howItems.text: We record facts and keep the evidence. The parties to the contract are you and your counterparty; reaching agreement is up to you.

howItems.title: A dispute is tied to a specific checklist item
howItems.text: Work cannot be rejected in free text — it takes an item and evidence. The criterion agreed in advance is what replaces an arbitrator here. A warranty claim has no stage and no item: it concerns the result of the contract as a whole.

howItems.title: Two rounds of fixes
howItems.text: The customer asks for a fix, the contractor submits again — and the acceptance period starts over. There is no third round.

howItems.title: A discount is made through an amendment
howItems.text: There is no separate «accept» button: acceptance is a signature from both sides. A discount covers only the defect named in it and does not waive your other claims.

howItems.title: One side does not decide for two
howItems.text: You always have a period in which to object to the other side's statement. Object — and the matter is discussed further. Stay silent — and we record that there were no objections: it affects neither the money nor the stage, but it stays on file.

howItems.title: The hard limit is 30 days
howItems.text: If you have not come to terms: accepted stages are paid to the contractor, the disputed one stays unpaid, and the failure to agree is recorded for both sides. It is an entry in reputation, not a penalty.

howItems.title: After that — the court
howItems.text: There is no binding arbitration on the platform. By then the correspondence, evidence, timestamps and hashes are already collected — the archive export hands them over.
